search.text: Filters the table as you type: the item's Arabic or English name or its code name. It changes no value.

food.chipAll: Shows every item in the table.
food.chipFamily: Shows one family of items, such as herbs or medicine. Bulk edit applies only to what is shown.
food.chipChanged: Shows only the items that differ from their original: the ones you are editing now and the ones saved before.
food.columns: Essential shows the main columns; All columns adds the running bar, gilding, drunk effect, poison and healing. It only changes your view.

bulk.text: Changes one column for every shown item at once: multiply, add, or set one number. Nothing is saved until you press Save and apply to everyone.
bulk.example: Hunger x 1.2 = an apple at 20 becomes 24

food.bulkColumn: The column that changes in every item shown now.
food.bulkOp: Multiply scales by a ratio, Add adds a number (a negative one subtracts), Set writes the same number for all.

bulkValue.text: The number the operation uses. The result is rounded to the nearest allowed value and never leaves the limits.

food.item: The item's name as the satchel shows it, with its family and code name below. Locked items are not eaten, so their numbers cannot change.

restoreRow.text: Returns every value of this item to the original the script shipped with. It applies only after Save and apply to everyone.
restoreRow.undo: Yes, type the number again and save

food.preview: A plain sentence of what happens in the game with the number you are editing now, next to the old one. It changes nothing.
food.drift: The developer changed the original number of these items after you edited them. Your value still applies; choose to keep it or take the new original.
food.keepMine: Keeps your number and takes the new original as its reference, so this notice goes away. Nothing changes for players.

takeNew.text: Drops your edit and goes back to the new original the developer wrote. Players get it after Save and apply to everyone.
takeNew.undo: Yes, type your number again and save

food.clearSearch: Clears the search and shows every item again.

food.previewIdle: Click any cell in the table to see here what its number means in the game.
food.kept: Your number stays; the notice is gone
food.driftTitle: The original changed after your edit (%s)
food.driftLine: “%s” — %s: the original was %s and is now %s; yours is %s
food.bulkScope: Applies to the items shown now: %s (%s). Locked items do not change.
food.bulkNone: No item changes with this number.
food.bulkClamped: %s of them stopped at the allowed limit
food.bulkDone: Changes added: %s. Review and save them

preview.hunger: Example: a player at %s hunger eats “%s” → %s hunger.
preview.hungerWas: After the change: a player at %s hunger eats “%s” → %s hunger (was %s).
preview.thirst: Example: a player at %s thirst drinks “%s” → %s thirst.
preview.thirstWas: After the change: a player at %s thirst takes “%s” → %s thirst (was %s).
preview.healNow: Gives %s health at once, about %s percent of full health.
preview.hurt: Takes %s health at once, about %s percent of full health.
preview.stamina: Fills %s of 100 in the small stamina circle, so the running bar comes back faster.
preview.staminaDown: Takes %s off the small stamina circle.
preview.core: Fills %s of 100 in the small health circle, so health comes back on its own faster.
preview.coreDown: Harms the small health circle by %s, like smoking.
preview.run: Refills %s percent of the running bar itself.
preview.noBuff: No buff: the item only fills, it leaves no lasting effect.
preview.buff: The “%s” buff lasts about %s seconds after eating.
preview.buffVegan: The “%s” buff lasts about %s seconds and adds about %s hunger and %s thirst meanwhile.
preview.goldHealth: Health turns gold and does not drop for %s seconds (%s).
preview.goldStamina: Stamina turns gold and does not drop for %s seconds (%s).
preview.poison: Poisoned for %s seconds, losing about %s health; poison stops at %s.
preview.horse_hunger: Fills the horse's hunger by %s of 100 when it eats “%s”.
preview.horse_stamina: Refills the horse's stamina by %s of 100 when it eats “%s”.
preview.horse_health: Restores the horse's health by %s of 100 when it eats “%s”.

food.takeNewQueued: “%s” goes back to the new original after Save and apply
food.cellUndo: Yes, with the item's Restore button or by typing the old number
